reply: Thank you for explaining that a $180.00 account reported as charged off keeps being reported monthly, and that you have not received the tax form or documents you asked for. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please dispute the account status with each credit reporting company, explain why you believe the reporting is inaccurate, and keep copies of your requests to the creditor. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a late payment is being reported on your card even though you believe a processing error on the company's side caused it. We understand how much this matters to you. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please gather proof of when you made the payment and when your statement arrived, since statements must be sent at least 21 days before the due date. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that disputed items remain on your credit report and that you have not received a description of how they were verified. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please ask in writing for the method used to verify each disputed item, and keep copies of your disputes. If you disagree with the result, you can ask for a reinvestigation. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your disputes were not processed because they were treated as coming from a third party, even after you confirmed by phone that they came from you. We understand the cost and effort involved. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please resend your dispute with a signed note that you are submitting it yourself, and keep your mailing receipts. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a charged-off account does not show the date of first delinquency, which affects how long it stays on your report and your home financing plans. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please dispute the missing date with each credit reporting company and the creditor, and include any statements that show when the account first became delinquent. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you dispute several negative accounts on your credit report and want proof that they are yours. We understand how this affects your ability to get credit. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please list each account, explain why you believe it is inaccurate, and include copies of supporting documents. Accurate negative information can stay on a report for several years. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that several items on your credit report appear incomplete or inaccurate. We understand why you want them corrected. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please list each item and describe what is inaccurate or incomplete about it, and keep copies of what you send. If the result of the investigation does not resolve it, you can ask for a reinvestigation. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that the open date, last active date and last reported date on an account are inaccurate, even though it was reported as properly investigated. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please send a dispute that lists each wrong date with the correct date and any proof you have. Checking for other common errors will also help. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that several accounts are still reported inaccurately after multiple disputes. We understand how frustrating that is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please also dispute directly with the companies that supplied the information. If they find it was wrong, they must tell every credit reporting company they reported to. Keep copies of every dispute. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that accounts appear on your consumer reports that you did not give permission to report. We understand your concern about your privacy. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please list the specific accounts you believe are not yours or are inaccurate and dispute them with each credit reporting company. If you disagree with the result, you can ask for a reinvestigation. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your credit report has several inaccuracies, including duplicated accounts, outdated collections, wrong account statuses and unauthorized inquiries. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please dispute each item with the credit reporting companies, explain what is wrong, and attach copies of your supporting documents. Personal information errors can be corrected the same way. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that a third-party collection account on your credit report is not one you agreed to. We understand why you want it verified. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please dispute the account with each credit reporting company, and ask the collector in writing for the information that shows the debt is yours. If you disagree with the result, you can ask for a reinvestigation. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your disputes are answered within a day without any sign of a full investigation. We understand your frustration with this. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please ask in writing for a description of how each disputed item was verified, and include any documents that support your dispute. You can ask for a reinvestigation if you disagree. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that disputed accounts on your credit report have not been corrected or removed despite the evidence you provided. We understand the ongoing harm you describe. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please resend your disputes with copies of your evidence and keep proof of when they were received. If you disagree with the outcome, you can request a reinvestigation. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that you asked for documents supporting delinquencies and late payments on your report and that nothing has been updated. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please list each item you dispute, explain why it is wrong, and include any payment records you have. Keep copies of your disputes and the dates sent. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your name and personal information on your credit report do not match your ID and other documents, and that you are preparing to buy a house. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please send a dispute letter with copies, not originals, of your ID and documents, and highlight the information that needs correcting. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that several charged-off accounts still show balances you believe are inaccurate, despite your earlier dispute. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please dispute each account again, explaining which balance is wrong and why, and include copies of any statements showing the correct amounts. Keep copies of everything you send. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that disputed accounts on your credit report were not corrected or removed even though you provided evidence. We understand how this is affecting your credit standing. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please send your disputes again with copies of your evidence and ask for the results in writing. If you disagree with the outcome, you can request a reinvestigation. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for listing the accounts and inquiries on your credit report that you dispute. We understand how they affect your ability to obtain credit. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please explain for each item what is inaccurate and include copies of any supporting records. Checking your report for common errors, such as duplicate accounts or wrong dates, can help. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a car loan paid off by your insurer after your car was totaled now shows as a charge-off with a $6,000.00 balance. We understand how sudden this change was. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please dispute the account with each credit reporting company and include the insurance payoff letter and any statement showing a zero balance. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a child support debt appears on your credit report, and that the child support office told you it does not report to credit bureaus. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please dispute the item with each credit reporting company and ask who supplied the information. Keep a copy of what the child support office told you. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for sharing your concern that accounts are listed on your consumer report without your written consent. We understand you want your report to be accurate. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please identify each account you believe is not yours or is inaccurate and dispute it with the credit reporting companies. You can request a reinvestigation if you disagree with the outcome. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you want certain transactions removed from your consumer report because you did not authorize them. We understand your request. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please list the specific items and explain why each is unauthorized or inaccurate. You can request a free copy of your checking account consumer report to see what is reported. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that charge-offs, collections and inquiries you dispute remain on your report, and that you did not receive the results of earlier reinvestigations. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please list each item with the reason you dispute it and keep proof of when your earlier disputes were sent. If you disagree with the result, you can request a reinvestigation. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that items you disputed with the credit bureaus have not changed on your reports. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please send a dispute that clearly identifies each item and explains why it is wrong. While an investigation is open, the disputed debt is marked on your report. Keep copies of everything you send. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that late payments appeared after your card account moved to a new company, and that the opening dates and balances differ between reports. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please dispute the late payments and the wrong dates with each credit reporting company and with the company that now holds the account, and include your screenshots and statements. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a collection account for another person with a similar name has been placed on your credit report twice. We understand how this affected your refinancing. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Accounts belonging to someone with a similar name are a common error, so please dispute it with each credit reporting company and include proof of your identity. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that you are still waiting for a response to your disputes while you try to buy a home. We understand how stressful this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. While a dispute is under investigation, it is noted on your report and may not count toward your score. Please keep copies of your dispute letters and the dates sent. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that accounts you do not recognize suddenly appeared on your credit report. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please dispute each account with the credit reporting companies, include the documents you have, and keep reviewing your reports regularly. If you think this is identity theft, report it through the federal identity theft website. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that inquiries you did not authorize remain on your credit report even after you were told they would be removed. We understand your concern about identity theft. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please dispute each inquiry in writing, and if you believe your identity was misused, report it through the federal identity theft website. You will receive an update once the review is complete.
